provenance.name: Asteroids with a page and no map marker

products.label: JPL Horizons, through each asteroid package
products.process: Take every asteroid package that is not a JPL mission target; read the position its package is prepared at; draw one dot there.
limitations: The dots are not clickable or named; these asteroids are reached through search or the Asteroids list.
Every dot is the neutral grey of the other asteroid dots, and its size and opacity are display choices.
